Camtek supply chain single source suppliers risk factors 20-F

findings.claim: Q1 2026 財報電話會議報導：Camtek 以色列設施在中東局勢困難下照常運作，未曾錯過出貨；主要製造與研發在以色列 Migdal Haemek，並在歐洲擴充產能作為對沖
findings.source: MarketBeat, Camtek Q1 earnings call highlights

findings.claim: 20-F（FY2020 版，較舊）揭露依賴單一／有限來源供應商與分包商（Key Suppliers）提供關鍵零組件與子系統
findings.excerpt: Camtek relies on single source and limited source suppliers and subcontractors ("Key Suppliers") for a number of essential components and subsystems of its products.

findings.claim: Q2 2026 財報電話會議摘要：管理層預期中國占 2026 年營收約 45%（前一年 49%）
findings.source: MarketBeat, Camtek Q2 earnings call highlights
findings.excerpt: Management said China business has remained stable over the past several years and expects revenue from China to account for roughly 45% of total revenue in 2026, compared with 49% in the prior year.

geo_supply_chain.note: 未找到台灣專屬曝險數字；2025 Q2 call 摘要稱中國約30%，與 49% 數字不一致，需對公司文件核對。最新 20-F 風險因子未讀到。
